items.text: Zay Flowers (hamstring) remains a true GTD with Ravens not counting on him; ETR/Levitan projecting him OUT in current projections with late-swap contingency for Bateman/Andrews DFS.
items.why: Team sources say not counting on him; pregame workout planned but low expectation
items.implication: Fade Flowers; elevate Bateman/Andrews/Likely in Ravens pass game if OUT
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for secondary Ravens WRs/TEs

items.text: No fresh info yet on DJ Moore (shoulder); Levitan/ETR assuming IN but limited in projections (1pm game). AD Mitchell assuming OUT.
items.why: No update as of ~9am ET; 1pm kick
items.opportunity: If limited or out, Kincaid/Coleman elevated

items.text: Caleb Williams Grade 2 hamstring, 3-4 week timeline per doctors (Schefter/Rapoport); noted quick healer hoping to beat it. OUT this week.
items.implication: Bagent or backup QB stream; Bears pass catchers downgraded short-term
items.opportunity: Bagent if cleared; Moore/Odunze/Loveland volume with backup

items.text: Steelers WR Michael Pittman (foot/plantar fasciitis), listed questionable, is expected to play vs Bengals after one week out.
items.implication: WR2/flex viable; monitor snap share on return
items.opportunity: Targets return to Pittman; reduces others

items.text: Steelers RB Jaylen Warren (shoulder), listed questionable, is expected to play vs Bengals.
items.why: Schefter report; aligns with ETR expected list
items.implication: Start with confidence; full or near-full role likely
items.opportunity: RB snaps/carries/targets secure; Dowdle OUT boosts him further

items.text: Brock Bowers (knee) and Mike Evans (hip) projected IN by Levitan/ETR despite Q tags; Rapoport confirms Evans good to go.
items.why: ETR expected list + Levitan projections; Rapoport on Evans
items.opportunity: Full routes/targets for Bowers; Evans WR volume

items.text: Saquon Barkley and DeVonta Smith expected to play (ETR); Schefter confirmed both officially off injury report and good to go for MNF vs Bears.
items.why: ETR expected; Schefter official off IR report
items.implication: Full start both; Eagles offense intact

items.text: Puka Nacua doubtful for SNF at Denver with groin injury impacting explosiveness; functionally can play but short-term, possible return next week vs Eagles; surgery not expected.
items.why: Schefter details on groin/explosiveness; Rams view short-term
items.implication: Sit this week; stash for Week 4+
items.opportunity: Adams/Kupp or other Rams WRs elevated if OUT

items.text: Nico Collins OUT again (hamstring) with decent chance to return Week 4 vs Cowboys.
items.why: Ruled out second straight week; source on W4 chance

items.text: ETR Fri list key OUTs: Nico Collins, Rico Dowdle, Jayden Daniels, Jonathon Brooks, Alec Pierce, Jaxson Dart etc. Key INs: JK Dobbins, RJ Harvey, Malik Nabers, Travis Etienne, Jadarian Price.
items.implication: Clear roles for beneficiaries; sit OUTs
items.opportunity: Warren (Dowdle out); Hubbard (Brooks); Nabers full; Dobbins/Harvey back

items.text: Post-fumble, TreVeyon Henderson led Pats backfield 65% snaps and out-touched Stevenson 16-5 rest of game; gap narrowed but Berry still ranks Stevenson ahead W3.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps if Stevenson struggles again

items.text: Schultz 28-30% target share/routes with Collins out (soft IND TE matchup); London avgs 20+ PPR/35% ts/97 yds with Penix; Hubbard firmly lead RB post-Brooks IR.
items.why: Collins absence; Penix chemistry; Brooks IR
items.opportunity: TE targets; WR1 volume; RB lead role

items.text: Jayden Daniels should be back within 3 weeks (Rapoport GameDay).
items.implication: Mariota start; McLaurin etc. continue with backup

items.text: Panthers WR Jalen Coker (ankle) should play; Xavier Legette GTD. ETR lists Coker expected.
Berry LOVES Derrick Henry vs DAL: highest rush prop 88.5, Dallas 30th rush D allowing 173.5 ypg.
items.why: Elite matchup vs soft run D + high prop

items.text: Berry LOVES Chase Brown @ PIT: 20+ touches + 15% targets both weeks, RB7 util; PIT 5th-most rush yds to RBs.
Berry LOVES Chris Olave (vs LV, 10+ tgts, high aDOT, LV soft vs WR), Dalton Schultz (@IND, 28% ts w/ Collins out, IND soft vs TE), Christian Watson (vs ATL, WR8 util, high RZ share).
items.opportunity: Olave air yards; Schultz TE targets; Watson RZ

items.text: Berry HATES Rhamondre Stevenson (@JAX, post-fumble 31% snaps/5 touches, tough run D), Travis Etienne (vs LV, only 49% touches/38% 3rd-down snaps), Terry McLaurin (vs SEA, worst WR fantasy D + low team total).
items.opportunity: Henderson rising; Hubbard lead; others over McLaurin
